messages.subject: Shiny hosting and RODBC
parts: I've got a Shiny hosting account at spark.rstudio.com, and the Shiny app I'm trying to run depends on an ODBC connection to an Oracle database. I usually establish the connection via RODBC's odbcConnect(). My app works great locally, but when it tries to run on Spark I get the following message:  "ERROR: first argument is not an open RODBC channel". This tells me that the ODBC connection isn't being established... I'm assuming this is because the DSN I'm referencing hasn't been set up server-side. Would this problem be solved if I downloaded Shiny Server and started using that instead?
